messages:
maya: Quick ask — we're targeting the 3.4.1 launch next week. Need a short 30m "launch checkpoint" sync to sign off the cut. Who must be in the room? Thinking: eng leads, infra, SRE, product PM, security. Proposed slots: Mon 10:00am PT, Mon 4:00pm PT, Tue 8:00am PT. Please react with ✅ for your preferred slot or reply with blackout times. Also add who should co-own rollback and who will run the canary.

aj: ✅ Mon 10:00am PT works for me. I'll own rollback runbook and be available on the call.

devon: Prefer Tue 8:00am PT (earlier in EMEA friendly). Quick checklist for the sync:
```
- RFC final signoff
- Canary plan + traffic ramp
- Metrics & alert thresholds
- Rollback steps and owners
- Smoke validation steps
```
We need RFC merged by EOD Fri.

katie: Security: we need all artifacts by Thu 9:00am PT to complete the final review. Add legal/privacy to attendees as required. Also flag export-control review if any models or datasets changed. :mag:

maya: Draft agenda — short & focused:
```
1) Quick status & blockers (5m)
2) RFC / design signoff (10m)
3) Canary & traffic ramp (7m)
4) Rollback ownership & steps (5m)
5) Post-cut triage contacts (3m)
```
Any additions?

aj: pls add "traffic ramp plan" explicitly under canary. Also ping infra-oncall to ensure capacity. :point_up:

devon: I'll drop the CR link + perf microbench results in this thread. Gate condition: p95 inference latency < 200ms on staging with 1x traffic.

ops-bot: Tentative event created for Mon 10:00am PT — invite sent to maya, aj, devon, katie, infra-oncall. RSVP by EOD today to lock. Calendar: <https://calendar.example/evt/abc123>

maya: If Mon 10:00am gathers the most ✅ we'll lock it by noon. Default fallback is Tue 8:00am PT. Volunteers for canary run ownership?

aj: I'll volunteer for canary rollback coordination as well (happy to pair with devon on validation).

devon: I'll own canary validation & smoke test scripts — will push by Thu morning.

maya: Great — locking Mon 10:00am PT as primary. Actions:
- aj: update rollback doc
- devon: push smoke tests & CR link
- katie: send security artifacts to security review
I'll follow up with final agenda + updated invite. Thanks all :party_parrot:
